page_title: ALM 1-3 RSO | Almeria v Real Sociedad 11/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+12' That's it for today, Isidro Diaz de Mera has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+10' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) is flagged for offside.
90+8' Almeria couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
90+5' 1 - 3 GOAL! The corner comes over and Aritz Elustondo wins a simple header before Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) nods the ball into the back of the net. 1:3.
90+5' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

90+4' Carlos Fernandez (Real Sociedad) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick.
90+4' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Real Sociedad, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

90+4' Houboulang Mendes (Almeria) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Real Sociedad, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
90+2' Substitution. Dion Lopy walks off the pitch and Marciano Sanca (Almeria) comes on as a substitute.
90+2' Dion Lopy (Almeria) goes into the book and receives a yellow card.
90+1' 1 - 2 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Carlos Fernandez (Real Sociedad) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Luis Maximiano no chance!
90+1' Carlos Fernandez (Real Sociedad) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90+1' It’s a PENALTY to Real Sociedad after the VAR review!
90' There will be a minimum of 10 min. of added time.
89' Referee Isidro Diaz de Mera makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Real Sociedad. Let’s see what happens!
89' Surely that's handball by one of the Almeria players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
88' Real Sociedad take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
88' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Real Sociedad) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. It will be a corner kick for Real Sociedad.
87' The substitution is prepared. Iddrisu Baba Mohammed (Almeria) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Sergio Arribas.
85' Sergio Arribas (Almeria) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
84' Largie Ramazani (Almeria) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
84' That was close by Carlos Fernandez (Real Sociedad)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.
83' Largie Ramazani (Almeria) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
81' Substitution. Benat Turrientes did his best and is replaced by Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad).

79' Leo Baptistao (Almeria) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Isidro Diaz de Mera no option but to blow his whistle. Real Sociedad get a free kick.
76' 1 - 1 Goal! Sergio Arribas (Almeria) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 1:1.
76' Lazaro (Almeria) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Alex Remiro makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.
74' That will be all from Arsen Zakharyan who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Mohamed-Ali Cho (Real Sociedad).
72' It's time for a substitution. Lazaro (Almeria) comes on in place of Adrian Embarba.
71' Gaizka Garitano prepares a substitution. Lucas Robertone is replaced by Gonzalo Melero (Almeria).
68' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Largie Ramazani (Almeria) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
66' Today's match ends for Mikel Oyarzabal who will be replaced by Carlos Fernandez (Real Sociedad).
66' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Almeria, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
65' Isidro Diaz de Mera interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad). Almeria have a free kick.
62' 0 - 1 Goal! The resulting corner is whipped into the box and Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) buries the ball into the back of the net from a Aritz Elustondo knock down. 0:1.
62' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

62' Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession. The ball goes out for a corner. Real Sociedad can continue in their attacking effort.
60' Celebrations are cut short for Real Sociedad as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was handball!
59' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was a handball in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Real Sociedad players aren’t happy.
58' Goal! Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) coolly slotted the ball past the goalkeeper.
53' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) fires the ball in from a mid-range free kick, but it blazes over the bar.
50' The game is interrupted. Adrian Embarba (Almeria) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
49' A corner kick by Almeria is thwarted by the well prepared Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad).
48' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Almeria. Almeria win a corner.
48' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Sergio Arribas (Almeria), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Good work from Almeria as they win a corner.
47' Almeria take a short corner kick.
46' The game is over for Ander Barrenetxea. Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) comes on for the second half.
46' Imanol Alguacil has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) comes on the pitch for Umar Sadiq.
46' The whistle blows and Isidro Diaz de Mera starts the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort. The ball goes out of play and Almeria will have a goal kick.

45+2' Luis Maximiano makes a brilliant save! Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the top left corner but is saved by the keeper! Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) receives a yellow card.
43' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar.
41' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt.

41' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Isidro Diaz de Mera blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
40' Leo Baptistao (Almeria) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
38' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) unleashed a promising strike from a long-distance free kick, but his attempt flies way wide of the right post and it's going to be a goal kick.

37' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Isidro Diaz de Mera stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. It's a free kick to Almeria, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
36' The corner is swung in but Almeria can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
32' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
32' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.

31' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
27' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Isidro Diaz de Mera had an easy-decision to make.
22' Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) commits a rough challenge and Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle for a foul.
20' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) pounces on a cross into the middle of the box, but plants his header well wide of the right post.
18' A bullet header by Chumi (Almeria) from inside the box has the power, but goes totally in the wrong direction, yards over the crossbar.
17' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Isidro Diaz de Mera has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
15' That's unlucky! Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
15' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.

12' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) skilfully dribbles past two defenders and runs into open space just outside the box to release a bullet. The ball only bounces off the left post, so the score doesn't change.
9' Edgar Gonzalez (Almeria) is penalised for holding. Isidro Diaz de Mera signals a set piece.
9' The linesman signals that Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
6' The corner kick from Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
2' Isidro Diaz de Mera blows for a foul after Leo Baptistao (Almeria) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Isidro Diaz de Mera was nominated as the referee for this game.
